description: Upgrade an existing Type 2 (non-formal) feature to Type 3 (formal): read its log, build a pre-filled formal-feature draft from it (feature name, target files, problem reconstructed from the opening request + success criteria), write the draft, and return the review prompt + dashboard form URL. The developer then fills in the structured tests / reference image in the dashboard. Parity with the extension's 'Upgrade to Type 3' button.
name: cpfs_upgrade_to_type3
